01 · Correct logo system

The icon and the name are not forced together in every placement. Use the symbol by itself for app icons and avatars.

A. Full logo lockup — for website, signage and documents

Use when there is enough horizontal or vertical space for the symbol, name and tagline.

B. Symbol only — app / profile icon

No wordmark and no tagline inside the icon. Use a clean square background for app-store versions.

C. Icon background variations — concept previews

09 · Trademark preparation

Use this as a brief for a qualified trademark professional; it is not legal clearance.

Proposed word mark

ZEROTHAM

Device mark concept

Growth Infinity symbol with leaf; consider filing the word mark and device mark separately after professional advice.

Business description draft

Mobile application and digital platform for listing and facilitating library/study-space bookings, fitness services, co-working bookings, exam-preparation/coaching courses, and related educational and digital services.

Classes to discuss

Before filing
Important: This kit does not confirm that ZEROTHAM or the logo is available or registrable. The original artwork is a raster reference, not final editable trademark artwork. Obtain official register searches and professional clearance before filing or spending heavily on production.
